name: Back Extension
instructions: Set the pad just below your hip crease and hook your heels under the rollers.
Cross your arms over your chest and hang down from the hips with a neutral spine.
Raise your torso by squeezing your glutes until your body is in a straight line.
Pause briefly at the top without arching further.
Lower slowly back to the start.
longevityNotes: Hip-hinge strength protects the lower back in every lift, from groceries to grandchildren. Strong glutes and hamstrings are the engine of walking, climbing, and standing up.
overview: A bodyweight hip-extension exercise that trains the lower back, glutes and hamstrings.
